verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Memory MCP Server explicitly enabling Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others to connect to a shared end-user memory graph, with a runtime probe confirming the endpoint is live and IdP-gated as documented. This directly satisfies the story of connecting multiple off-the-shelf assistants to shared memory; missing for 10: independent hands-on multi-assistant test showing simultaneous cross-tool memory sharing in practice.
